description: Ask a question, such as a buyer would, and get the passages that answer it best, and each site once by its best passage under "bySite", from the sites closest to the question, one market, or named sites. At most 12 sites are read. Passages come under "quoted". Close means similar in meaning, not right, and not cited by an assistant.

market.description: Only this market, named by the site at its centre, as mttr_markets gives it.

sites.description: Only these sites, as domains separated by commas.

name: mttr_search
title: Search by meaning
